responses.response: Select the continuous walked trace and exchanged witness as the single mechanic. Both route classes are equally complete; length and witness dependence persist without a narrative or musical ranking. Keep CG-05 reciprocal-reference establishment, CG-06 independent-test initiation, and CG-07 completed test as distinct facts. CG-05 requires W-7744 at the validated stable reference and the player's actual reciprocal passage; CG-06 requires that evidence plus physical clearance for his final span; CG-07 requires his actual grounded arrival and the retained reciprocal proof. Neither clearance nor starting to walk commits completion. The changed audit phrase belongs only to CG-07. The reciprocal passage uses the restrained demonstration texture, with no duet, cooperation meter, or success cue. Score owns its exact realization and handoff; music cannot delay any predicate or the return of free play.

The home review is an archived suit record under settled home/world sound. It has only the ordinary once-per-objective entry acknowledgement: no transmission, audit-theme reprise, unseen presence cue, or implication that W-7744 contacted Terra. In live play, the real install transaction clears its return objective and owns one bounded restoration acknowledgement; the new invitation publishes only after that acknowledgement's presentation ownership retires. Retirement is a UI/feedback boundary, not an audio-clock or player-listening prerequisite. A restored save derives the steady home state and omits the installation transient entirely. The audit reprise begins only at the actual renewed Origin inspection. The player can move, build, or leave the home offer pending throughout.

Confirm the walked trace and exchanged witness. Exclude a second marker-placement puzzle and exclude an independent marker-relocation climax. A minimal fixed reference/sighting apparatus may make the selected mechanic legible; it supplies no collection, carry, placement, or separate calibration gate. Retain the player's embodied view and camera/movement ownership, actual grounded tests, specific local refusal, both persistent route classes, and the required reciprocal comparison before W-7744's final independent traversal. W-7744 remains one bounded local tester on Origin after completion and on later visits; there is no farewell sequence or permanent retirement that removes the optional repeat experiment. Treatments remain immutable; this response records the selected candidate amendment, not a rewrite of the alternatives or closure of my outgoing objections.

Witness continuity is a world-space predicate. It never reads camera quaternion, screen visibility, reticle alignment, player look direction, a gaze dwell, music time, or optional foliage density. An offered intermediate reference records a grounded world position and identity. F offers it while the player occupies its inner cylinder. The player remains its witness while grounded in the same world inside the release cylinder and while the relevant worker-to-reference segment is clear against signed, tier-stable solid terrain/trunk geometry. The longer route uses the established fixed survey reference; the shorter route needs the offered occupied intermediate reference through its occluded bend. A newly drawn untested endpoint cannot silently become a replacement fixed reference and erase that distinction. W-7744's reciprocal reference is the corresponding actor-owned state: a validated safe pose, an explicitly established reference, and an unobstructed relation during the player's actual passage. Actor/instrument orientation presents that relation but render-camera orientation never decides it. Looking away changes nothing. Leaving the witness cylinder safely holds the worker at his last supported sample and preserves tested proof; returning to the inner cylinder resumes when the same offered reference and unwalked span are valid. Missing reference and invalid footing have different repair paths. All geometry values remain candidate values until actual route feasibility is demonstrated; signing the narrative candidate does not certify an unmeasured arena.
